text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“—Yeah, Mom. I'm coming home on my next 
day off.”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I'm so excited for my day off date 
with Mama~ It's been a while, so I'm 120 
miles of hype!☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The usual mall is fine for our 
destination, right? It's exactly one mile 
from home, and... huh?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The newly opened department store is 100 
miles of hype"? Whoa, tell me all about 
it!
